salesTax.permit: Minnesota sales tax permit (Minnesota Tax ID)

permitFee.note: Minnesota charges no fee to register for a Tax ID and sales tax account.

workersComp.agency: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry

unemployment.note: $10 per employee for a missing wage detail report, never less than $250, doubling if still unfiled 30 days after demand.

newHire.note: Up to $25 per newly hired employee, or up to $500 per employee for a conspiracy.

laborPosters.note: The commissioner may assess $500 for violating the workers' compensation posting requirement after notice (Minn. Stat. 176.139).

workersComp.note: $200 to $1,000 per uninsured employee per week, based on the avoided premium (Minn. R. 5220.2865).

paidLeave.title: Minnesota Paid Leave premiums
paidLeave.description: Employers remit premiums quarterly and may deduct up to half from employee wages.

local.description: Minnesota cities license specific activities; no general state-wide business license.
